title: Clearing year-end fee balances before January
description: A practical guide for Kenyan school bursars and principals on reducing outstanding fee balances at year end, so the January opening is not weighed down by arrears.
body:
Fee arrears carried into a new year do not shrink on their own. They tend to grow, as families face new fees on top of old balances. The weeks between the end of Term 3 and January are the best window to settle balances, if the school uses them deliberately.

The approach below keeps the focus on getting payment, while protecting learners and relationships.

Know the exact numbers early

Reconcile every learner account before the term closes: fees charged, payments received, and balance, matched against M-Pesa and bank records. Parents are far more likely to engage with a specific, accurate figure than with a vague reminder that something is owing.

Sort families by what they actually need

  • Forgetful payers: a clear statement and an easy payment link usually settles it.
  • Cash-flow constrained families: a documented payment plan that matches when they have income, for example after harvest or month end.
  • Families in genuine hardship: a conversation about bursary, NG-CDF, county or other support, early and privately.

Document every agreement: A payment plan that exists only in a phone call is a source of disputes in March. Record the amount, the dates, and who agreed, and share a confirmation message with the parent.

Use the holiday for payments

Many families are more able to pay during the holiday, when travel and other term expenses pause. Reminders sent through the break, with a direct M-Pesa payment option, collect more than letters sent home with students. Keep the tone respectful and the message short.

Say clearly what happens in January

Tell parents plainly how balances roll forward, what the January fee is, and what the school can and cannot do about unpaid fees. Remember that the law protects learners' access to education, so policies should focus on engagement and payment plans, not on sending children home.

Collect fees by M-Pesa, with automatic receipts.

Edupath SMS includes M-Pesa STK push, automated WhatsApp fee reminders, and real-time balances, so year-end reconciliation is quick. Free to start.
